messages.content: who were critics of nicolaus copernicus Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content:
Nicolaus Copernicus faced significant opposition during his lifetime. The Catholic Church initially resisted his heliocentric model. Many astronomers preferred the geocentric view for simplicity.

Did anyone praise his work? Yes, some humanists supported him. Others remained skeptical of his calculations.

What a bold challenge to tradition! His ideas sparked centuries of debate.
